cues: Vaccines come in several types: live but weakened, like B C G and measles; killed; just the key antigen, like hepatitis B; toxoids against tetanus; and now m R N A.
It began with Jenner in seventeen ninety six, using cowpox against smallpox, which was eradicated in nineteen eighty.
A vaccine gives artificial active immunity: your own body does the work, and remembers.
